features.description: Extract intent claims from ADR/decision documents into the architecture view-state intent layer Plan A reserved empty. Each claim is declared (source_kind adr, evidence_basis declared) with id, title, status, source path, decision text, and referenced symbols. Absence of ADRs degrades gracefully (empty claims, populated false) and the coverage block reports the doc/adr extractor honestly.
features.acceptance: given a repo with at least one decision document, build_view_state populates the intent layer with one declared intent_claim per document (id, title, status, source path, referenced symbols), evidence_basis declared and source_kind adr; given a repo with none, the intent layer stays empty with populated false and no crash; the coverage block marks the doc/adr extractor covered when claims exist and not_found when none.

features.description: Reconcile each intent claim against the as-built graph and populate the diff list Plan A reserved empty, keyed by the defined diff taxonomy. Conservative: emit only evidence-backed entries — aligned when a claim reference resolves to an as-built node, documented_unimplemented when it resolves to nothing, stale_adr for a superseded decision. The remaining taxonomy values stay reserved.
features.acceptance: build_view_state emits a diff list of intent_diff entries each tagged with one taxonomy value from the Plan A enum; a claim whose referenced symbol exists as_built yields aligned; a claim whose reference resolves to nothing yields documented_unimplemented; a superseded decision yields stale_adr; the reconciler is pure and deterministic and emits no entry it cannot back from evidence.
